reference_boundary.target_reference_boundary: prepare reads verified backgrounds and pilot_inputs (which has no reference/gold fields), serializing only ID, sample_id, source/changed span, target candidate, and backgrounds. infer reads score_plan and score_inputs only. report() separately opens pilot_labels and dataset/holdout sample references after scoring (script lines 127-135, 160-163).

scoring_design.scoring_matrix: For each condition, score both completions (source, changed) under both user-prompt hypotheses (source, changed): four causal-LM forward calls per input/condition.
scoring_design.forward_count_instrumentation_caveat: forward_calls=4 is hardcoded after the 4 score() calls, not incremented by a model-call hook. Every successfully appended row has run 4 score() calls, but interrupted attempts before append would not appear in scores.jsonl.

strategy_audit.frozen_plan_rule: Veto only when the changed-minus-source mean-token score is <= -threshold under BOTH input hypotheses; baseline replacements are only removed.
strategy_audit.implementation_lines: probe_entity_contrastive_score.py:102-112 creates the cross-scoring matrix; :141-148 applies veto; :150-159 reconstructs from initial text using kept existing changes.

non_preregistered_extension.reason: Symmetric both-prompts veto produced no changes; examine averaged margins as copying-bias diagnostic. Not independently preregistered.
non_preregistered_extension.decision: Average of target-minus-source mean token log probabilities under both hypothetical inputs <= -threshold. Veto existing changes only.
non_preregistered_extension.interpretation: This averages the two margins instead of requiring both to cross the threshold. It is a post-score development diagnostic, not a preregistered change to score_plan or score_inputs.
non_preregistered_extension.reported_outcome_not_independently_check: The parent reports that no average threshold qualifies; this audit did not read score_average_summary/score_average_changes.

concrete_limitations.finding: score() returns logs.mean() over every completion token (script lines 86-92); margins compare these whole-transcript means. Unchanged context can dominate/dilute a local entity signal, candidate/source token counts can differ, and tokenizer segmentation changes the denominator. Mean token log probability is not a calibrated likelihood ratio or entity-span score.

Each user prompt is literally one complete hypothesis and each completion is one complete hypothesis. Cross-scoring both hypotheses is symmetric and useful as a copying-bias diagnostic, but self-copying remains possible. The official-background system prompt also contains the canonical name and its description, so a score gain can reflect lexical prior/copying rather than evidence from audio.
The scorer is text-only and receives no waveform or ASR confidence. It measures model compatibility with text prompts, not whether the candidate was heard.

64 candidate inputs cover 63 sample IDs; one recording contributes two separate candidate spans. 57/64 rows have no background, making official_background identical to context_only for those cases. Threshold behavior is exploratory on a small development set.

report() reconstructs text from the frozen initial transcript plus kept baseline changes rather than rerunning the production/audio path. This is suitable for an offline veto simulation but is not an end-to-end deployed result or regenerated payload.

The plan states relative non-regression, while code uses hard-coded absolute gates hits>=100, errors<=33, absent_changes<6 and lost_reference_present_changes==0 (script lines 176-180). The latter lost-change test is canonical substring presence anywhere in the reference, not span-aligned gold support; report also uses reference-substring absent_changes. Prefer computing explicit per-target baseline deltas and aligned gold changes.

report() checks score row count and uniqueness but not that exact (id,condition) pairs equal the Cartesian input-by-condition set (script line 129). This audit found the completed score file has the exact expected pair set. Add an exact-set assertion to protect future runs.

infer() validates the score_inputs hash (script line 71), but does not revalidate background_sha256 or entity_module_sha256; report() imports the current system normalizer. The model path is recorded without a weights/tokenizer digest.

recommended_followups_not_applied: Keep score_average_plan explicitly post-score and out of the frozen plan/inputs; do not describe it as preregistered.
Assert the exact set of expected (input id, condition) pairs before report aggregation.
Instrument forward-call counts rather than writing a constant, and record model/tokenizer identity.
Report mean and total log probability separately, plus a span-focused score or calibrated validation if such a score will drive a veto.
Compare acceptance gates directly against computed baseline metrics and align lost-target checks to annotated spans.
